name: Grid-NeRF
definition: A two-branch model architecture that integrates grid-based and NeRF-based approaches under a joint learning scheme to render large urban scenes. It uses a compact multi-resolution ground feature plane to coarsely capture the scene and complements it with a NeRF branch for high-frequency details.
summary: Grid-NeRF renders large urban scenes by jointly optimizing a factorized feature grid and a NeRF branch, using the grid to guide sampling and inject features to reduce memory complexity and avoid blurring.
